biomarkers.name: SS18-SSX1 / SS18-SSX2 / SS18-SSX4 fusion (t(X;18))
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defining event; detected by molecular testing (e.g., FISH, RT-PCR, NGS); SS18-SSX/SSX fusion-specific or SS18-SSX surrogate antibody IHC may support diagnosis

biomarkers.name: NY-ESO-1
biomarkers.clinical_use: Afamitresgene autoleucel (afami-cel) — TCR-T targeting MAGE-A4, not NY-ESO-1, in HLA-A*02+ synovial sarcoma. NY-ESO-1 expression is relevant to investigational TCR-T approaches (e.g., letetresgene autoleucel in trials)

biomarkers.name: HLA-A*02:01
biomarkers.clinical_use: Required for selected TCR-T therapy eligibility

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Uniform spindle cells with variable glandular epithelial component; heterogeneous appearance despite name (does NOT arise from synovium)
variants: poorly differentiated / small round cell (worst prognosis)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: FNCLCC grade; poorly differentiated variant is worst

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Immune-cold — sparse TILs; but cancer-testis antigen expression can enable TCR-engineered T cell therapy
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Fibrous stroma with hemangiopericytoma-like vasculature; mast cells common; calcification in some

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Uncertain — DOES NOT arise from synovium despite the name; likely mesenchymal precursor with bipotent epithelial-mesenchymal differentiation capacity
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Monophasic (spindle only) or biphasic (spindle + epithelial glandular) with characteristic uniform spindle cell morphology; TLE1+, EMA+ variable
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: SS18-SSX1/SSX2/SSX4 fusion (t(X;18)) is defining — SS18 (SYT) is a chromatin-remodeling complex component, and the fusion disrupts BAF (SWI/SNF) complex composition; bipotent differentiation potential (spindle and epithelial) reflects fusion-driven chromatin state
